meta.title: Motir — AI planning, project management and agent orchestration
meta.description: The AI planning, project-management and agent orchestration platform. Describe what you want to build — Motir drafts the plan, then agents take over the work.

hero.headline: What do you want to build?
hero.lede: The AI planning, project-management and agent orchestration platform. Describe what you want to build — Motir drafts the plan with you, then agents take over the work.
hero.placeholder: Describe what you want to build — who it's for, and the core things people should be able to do. For example: a tool for freelancers to send invoices and track which clients have paid.
hero.hint: Start with a rough idea — Motir asks follow-up questions next. Free to start, no credit card.
hero.statusSubmitting: Saving your idea and taking you to Motir…
hero.errorTitle: We couldn't save your idea just now.
hero.errorBody: Nothing you typed has been lost. Try again, or continue to Motir and bring your idea with you.

new.title: Start something new
new.description: Describe it and Motir plans it with you — no code, no board, nothing yet.

import.title: I have an existing project
import.description: Motir reads what is already there and plans on top of it.

codebase.title: Your codebase
codebase.description: Connect a repository — Motir reads the code and plans on top of what is already built.

jira.title: Jira
jira.description: Bring existing work items across, with their structure intact.

doors.hint: Either way you end up with a plan you read and edit before anything is built. No credit card.

free.tail: — boards, sprints and a backlog, with no AI in the way.

pillars.headline: You've heard of vibe coding. This is a vibe project.
pillars.lede: You bring the idea. Motir carries it from a sentence to a shipped project — the planning, the tracking, and the work itself. And not only the code: design, decisions, content and tests are work items too.

planning.title: AI planning
planning.body: Describe what you want in your own words. Motir asks follow-up questions, then drafts a plan you read before anything is built — epics, stories and work items, with the dependencies between them.

projectManagement.title: Project management
projectManagement.body: A complete project-management tool underneath it all: boards, sprints, a backlog, roadmaps, dependencies, comments and reports. It stands on its own, whether or not you ever use the AI.

agents.title: Agent orchestration
agents.body: Approve the plan and agents take over the work, one work item at a time, each arriving as a pull request you review. Use Motir's agents, or your own.

openCore.title: Open core
openCore.body: The project-management core is open source under the GPL — the whole tool, not a cut-down edition. Run it yourself, read every line of it, or let us host it. AI planning and agent orchestration are the commercial layers on top.

designShowcase.heading: Pick a look. The whole site changes.
designShowcase.subline: This is the design system every Motir project starts with. It is here rather than in a styleguide because the fastest way to show what your product could look like is to let you restyle ours.

theme.name: Theme
theme.help: Light, dark, or match your device.

style.name: Style
style.help: The shape and feel — silhouette, elevation, density.

palette.name: Palette
palette.help: The colour scheme the interface wears.

type.name: Type
type.help: The typeface pairing for headings and body.

designShowcase.closing: The three axes here are the same three your project picks when you start one in Motir — and the same design system underneath. This site is not showing you a demo of it; it is built from it.

footer.tagline: The AI planning, project-management and agent orchestration platform.
footer.openSource: The project-management core is open source, GPL-3.0.
